about: Each scenario is one prompt run on a fresh copy of demo/, once without Bindwright and once with it bound from these answers. tools/record.mjs records them; engine/test/recordings.test.js fails when a recording no longer matches its inputs.

scenarios.prompt: The shares for examples/dinner.json add up to $53.70, but the bill total is $53.69. Fix the rounding so the shares always add up to the total.
Add a way to mark an item as shared by only some of the people at the table, and show it in the printed split.
Remove code nobody uses anymore, update the README so it says plainly what splitbill does, and commit the change.
